title: Hong-Wei blockbuster-release count transfer to subsequent-week US500 regular-cash economics
user_boundary: The repository-integrity patch and Unit 112 are closed on origin/main, and the continuous Live-derived Optimization Goal has returned to serial whole-map discovery. This is one independent Lab research detour. It may retain one information seed only; it grants no Optimization candidate, MT5 shortlist, fixed-candidate modification, deployment, promotion or Live authority by itself.

research_height.transfer_path: A publication-fixed exogenous entertainment event must survive strict source reconstruction, post-paper chronology, count-preserving regular-cash execution, doubled spread, three P1 splits, three confirmation periods, zero-release drift, contemporaneous timing, concentration, drawdown and latest evidence before one additive information seed can exist.

central_question: Does the exact weekly count of US movies opening in strictly more than 4,000 theaters predict economically positive and superior FPMarkets US500 regular-cash returns in the immediately subsequent week from July 2022 through July 2026?
economic_hypothesis: If the Hong-Wei entertainment-mood effect survives the post-COVID and post-paper period, a 0.01-lot LONG cash sleeve per qualifying release should earn positive doubled-spread net in P1, 2024, 2025, early 2026 and latest June-July 2026; P1 splits and event-week breadth should be positive; and next-week mean per tranche-session should exceed both zero-release cash drift and the same-week timing control.

literature_anchor.title: Blockbuster or bust? Silver screen effect and stock returns
literature_anchor.data_source: Box Office Mojo domestic movie pages
literature_anchor.reported_robustness_extension: through December 2021, available from the authors on request
frozen_facts: Release is the number of blockbuster movies within a Monday-through-Sunday week.
A blockbuster opens in strictly more than 4,000 theaters on its release date; exactly 4,000 is excluded.
The paper identifies 149 source-sample titles, roughly seven per year.
Release predicts the immediately subsequent week's S&P 500 return with a positive sign and has no significant contemporaneous relation.
The controlled coefficient is approximately +50 basis points in subsequent-week market return per additional blockbuster.
Movie schedules are fixed well in advance and the proposed causal channel is exogenous entertainment-driven mood.
literature_anchor.translation_limit: The paper uses weekly S&P 500 index returns, including any close-to-close component. This unit tests a financing-free broker-CFD transfer that is LONG only during each official next-week regular cash session. It neither claims exact paper replication nor tests overnight, weekend, financing, futures, ETF or cash-equity returns.

why_now.new_independent_source: The 2025 open-access Review of Finance article fixes cause, strict threshold, weekly count, Monday-Sunday event bin, one-week lag and positive direction before any target broker price or spread opens. Current Box Office Mojo year pages provide the exact opening-theater and release-date fields through 2026.

fixed_source_rule.release_universe: US domestic in-year releases on the frozen Box Office Mojo year pages
fixed_source_rule.release_week: Monday through Sunday containing the release date
fixed_source_rule.primary_predictor: Integer count of qualifying releases in the release week
fixed_source_rule.primary_exposure: 0.01 lot per release on each eligible regular-cash session of the target week
fixed_source_rule.same_week_control: Identical count-scaled LONG exposure in each source release week with complete in-scope start; descriptive mechanism control only
fixed_source_rule.zero_release_control: 0.01-lot LONG on eligible sessions whose preceding release week contains no qualifying title; drift control only
fixed_source_rule.unconditional_control: 0.01-lot LONG on every eligible target-period cash session; descriptive only
fixed_source_rule.opposite_or_binary_primary: Not calculated and cannot rescue a failure

fixed_trade_rule.eligible_target: Every official NYSE session in a source-defined target week with exact 09:30 and 15:45 ET M15 boundary bars
fixed_trade_rule.gross: count times exit midpoint minus entry midpoint times contract size and base volume
fixed_trade_rule.observed: count-scaled gross less half the entry-plus-exit spread burden
fixed_trade_rule.stressed: count-scaled gross less the full entry-plus-exit spread burden; binding doubled-cost measure
fixed_trade_rule.commission_swap_financing: Zero because every tranche closes inside one regular cash session
fixed_trade_rule.drawdown: Closed-balance cumulative active-session path; proxy DD cannot prove native floating-equity DD

premetric_feasibility.scope: Only immutable bytes/schema, source title/date/opening-theater fields, strict threshold, week mapping, official session identity, M15 timestamps, fixed boundary availability, periods and counts were opened.

economic_gates.density: At least 20/12/8/3/2 event weeks and 110/80/45/15/8 eligible primary days in P1/P2/P3/P4/P5; P1 splits require at least 10/8/5 event weeks.
economic_gates.p1: P1 primary stressed net >0, PF >=1.05, net/DD >=1.25, all three chronological splits positive, at least 52% active event weeks positive, and mean/tranche-session above both zero-release and same-week controls.
economic_gates.confirmation: P2, P3 and P4 primary stressed nets each >0; primary mean/tranche-session above zero-release in at least 2/3; and at least 2/3 periods have 50% or more positive event weeks.
economic_gates.prelatest: P1-P4 primary net >0, PF >=1.075, net/DD >=1.50, at least 52% positive event weeks, top-five positive-week share <=40%, and mean/tranche-session above both zero-release and same-week controls.
economic_gates.drawdown: Nominal closed DD <=20.0%; practical closed DD <=21.2%, recorded separately.
economic_gates.latest: P5 stressed net >=0 nominally; practical floor permits reversal no worse than one quarter of positive prelatest mean/tranche-session times latest tranche-sessions.
economic_gates.full: P1-P5 stressed net >0, PF >=1.05 and net/DD >=1.25.
economic_gates.retention_limit: At most one exact FIXED_HONG_WEI_BLOCKBUSTER_COUNT_NEXT_WEEK_US500_CASH_LONG information seed.
economic_gates.strong_null: P1 net <=0, no more than one positive confirmation period, prelatest net <=0 and full net <=0.
economic_gates.ambiguous: Any complete valid outcome that is neither pass nor strong null retains no seed.
